name: ui-lantern-tap
prompt: A short soft fingertip tap on a paper lantern shell, gentle muted papery thump with a faint bamboo rattle, dry and close, no reverb tail.

name: ui-menu-select
prompt: A light wooden clave click paired with a tiny brass bell ping, crisp and friendly UI confirmation, short decay, intimate hall acoustics.

name: call-ball-draw
prompt: A small wooden bingo ball rattling up a bamboo chute and landing with a hollow knock, followed by a soft announce chime, warm hall ambience.

name: call-number-chime
prompt: Two gentle struck notes on a small brass singing bowl, rising pitch, clear ringing tone that announces a drawn number, soft room reverb.

name: mark-paper-stamp
prompt: A round rubber stamp pressing firmly onto a paper card, soft thud with an inky squelch and slight paper fiber texture, single decisive stamp.

name: mark-ink-dab
prompt: A felt-tip bingo dauber dabbing once onto cardboard, wet inky dot sound with a soft fibrous press, short and satisfying.

name: invalid-wood-thud
prompt: A dull muffled knock on a thick wooden table, low and discouraging, no ring, clearly signaling a rejected action.

name: invalid-brush-scratch
prompt: A dry brush bristle scratch across rough paper, one quick downward stroke, slightly harsh, signaling something not allowed.

name: line-lantern-glow
prompt: A warm rising shimmer of small tuned metal chimes, three ascending bright notes with a glowing whoosh of a paper lantern flaring up gently.

name: line-chime-rise
prompt: Three ascending struck glass chime notes, each brighter than the last, celebratory but small, gentle hall reverb tail.

name: win-festival-fanfare
prompt: A short festive fanfare of small temple bells and a bamboo flute flourish, joyful rising melody ending on a bright gong shimmer, night market celebration.

name: win-bingo-bells
prompt: A cheerful cascade of brass hand bells ringing in a quick ascending pattern, ending with a resonant small gong strike and sparkling decay.

name: lose-paper-sigh
prompt: A soft descending sigh made of rustling paper and a low flute note falling in pitch, gentle disappointment, no harshness.

name: lose-ember-fade
prompt: A single warm ember pop followed by a low fading gong hum that slowly dies out, quiet and somber, end of a lost round.

name: tick-clock-tap
prompt: A single precise tick of a small mechanical clock escapement, dry wooden click, very short, quiet countdown cue.

name: tick-wood-tick
prompt: A thin bamboo stick tapping once on a hollow wood block, crisp high click with minimal resonance, metronome-like urgency cue.
